an6.17:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an6.17:1.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenupaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an6.17:1.3: āyasmāpi kho sārīputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenupaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an6.17:1.12: āyasmāpi kho kho ānando sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenupaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an6.17:1.13: atha kho bhagavā bahudeva rattiṃ nisajjāya vītināmetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an6.17:1.14: tepi kho āyasmanto acirapakkantassa bhagavato uṭṭhāyāsanā yathāvihāraṃ agamaṃsu.
an6.17:1.15: ye pana tattha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ te yāva suriyassuggamanā kākacchamānā supiṃsu.
an6.17:1.16: addasā kho bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena te bhikkhū yāva suriyassuggamanā kākacchamāne supante
an6.17:1.17: disvā yenupaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi
an6.17:2.11: kahaṃ nu kho te bhikkhave therā sāvakā gatāti
an6.17:2.12: tepi kho bhante āyasmanto acirapakkantassa bhagavato uṭṭhāyāsanā yathāvihāraṃ agamaṃsūti
an6.17:2.13: tena no tumhe bhikkhave therā bhikkhū navā yāva suriyassuggamanā kākacchamānā supatha
an6.17:2.15: apinu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā
an6.17:2.16: rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto yāvadatthaṃ seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharanto yāvajīvaṃ rajjaṃ kārento janapadassa vā piyo manāpoti
an6.17:2.19: mayāpi kho etaṃ bhikkhave neva diṭṭhaṃ na sutaṃ
an6.17:2.20: rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto yāvadatthaṃ seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharanto yāvajīvaṃ rajjaṃ kārento janapadassa vā piyo manāpoti
